clue.text: As old prophet might put it e.g., "O Thou! — whatever title suit thee …"

definitions.text: O Thou! — whatever title suit thee

indicators.note: how the letters might be put, i.e. arranged in another order, signals a reshuffle of the pieces

explanation.surface: A quotation from Burns's address to the Devil, presented as the way an Old Testament prophet might speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might put it' shuffles AS, O (old) and PROPHET. The quoted line opens Burns's 'Address to the Deil', a speech aimed at an absent figure, and continues into 6 across.
explanation.definitionFit: In rhetoric, a sudden address to an absent person or thing, such as Burns calling out to the Devil, is this figure of speech.

clue.text: Hermitage has a room that's empty redecorated

indicators.note: redecorating changes the arrangement, so the letters are reordered
an empty word has its inside removed, leaving just the outer letters

explanation.surface: A retreat has a vacant room that has been done up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's empty' leaves RM of room; 'redecorated' shuffles HAS, A and RM.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a religious retreat in India, a place of seclusion like a hermit's dwelling.

clue.text: Jeweller stocking ring for a bird

indicators.note: ring for a means the O replaces the A

parts.note: Asprey is a famous London jeweller
a ring is round, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A jeweller stocking a ring intended for a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' puts O in place of the A of ASPREY, the London luxury goods and jewellery firm.
explanation.definitionFit: The osprey is a fish-eating bird of prey.

clue.text: Programme for passing on: Top Gear and all connected with it

definitions.meaning: a broadcast show on radio or television
the conveying of something from one to another, as of a disease

definitions.text: Top Gear and all connected with it
definitions.meaning: a car's gears and the drive mechanism linked to them

explanation.surface: Top Gear, the BBC motoring show, and its whole production being broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: Top Gear is a long-running British TV motoring programme, but here top gear is the highest gear of a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a broadcast, the act of conveying, and a vehicle's gearbox system.

clue.text: A line of players in old English clubhouse

indicators.note: the clubhouse letters are placed within the old English pair

parts.note: O for old and E for English
CH is the map abbreviation for clubhouse, as on golf course maps

explanation.surface: A team of players lined up in an old English clubhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: CH goes 'in' between O and E. The players are darts players.
explanation.definitionFit: The oche is the line behind which darts players must stand to throw.

clue.text: Loose-head forward finally trained as N. Atlantic swimmer

indicators.note: training reshapes, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, a rugby front-row position

indicators.note: only the closing letter of forward is used

explanation.surface: A rugby loose-head prop, a forward, ends up trained as a swimmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trained' rearranges LOOSEHEAD plus D. In rugby, the loose-head prop is a front-row forward.
explanation.definitionFit: The hooded seal is a large seal of the Arctic and North Atlantic, the male having an inflatable nasal sac.

clue.text: … name I see? King

parts.note: the letter C sounds like the word see, as in text-speak
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Continuing 1 across, the speaker wonders which of the Devil's many names to use, then lands on a regal one.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries on Burns's line, which lists the Devil's names: 'Auld Hornie, Satan, Nick, or Clootie'.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Nick is a traditional nickname for the Devil, one of the titles Burns offers him.

clue.text: Often Vergilian representation omits to give elements of the underworld

indicators.note: a rearrangement of the first words that leaves out the letters of to give

explanation.surface: A depiction of Virgil's often-described underworld that gives its elements.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange OFTEN VERGILIAN and remove the letters of TO GIVE; the eight left spell the answer. Virgil's Aeneid book 6 describes the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: Infernal comes from Latin infernus, lower, and describes anything belonging to hell or the nether regions.

clue.text: Cambodia and Uruguay may with a Japanese rickshaw man

parts.note: K is Cambodia's international vehicle registration code
URU is the sporting abbreviation for Uruguay

explanation.surface: Cambodia and Uruguay might join up with a Japanese rickshaw puller.
explanation.walkthrough: The vehicle code for Uruguay is ROU; URU is the abbreviation used in sport.
explanation.definitionFit: The kurumaya is the man who pulls a rickshaw in Japan, the kuruma being the vehicle.

clue.text: Power to halt jumps in women's two-day event

indicators.note: these pieces sit inside the word for women's, which wraps around them

parts.note: a hen party or hen night is one for women only
P is the physics abbreviation for power

indicators.note: letters that jump about are scrambled, so to and halt get reordered

explanation.surface: A sporting moment where strength brings a competitor to a stop in a women's athletics contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumps' scrambles the pieces after P, and 'in' places the whole run inside the women's word, as in a hen night.
explanation.definitionFit: The seven-discipline athletics competition for women is staged over two consecutive days.

clue.text: The essence of hunting trip, one in Africa

indicators.note: the essence is the heart, so the outer letters of the trip word are trimmed off

parts.note: a safari is a hunting expedition, especially in East Africa

explanation.surface: The core of a big-game expedition is being in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The essence of' strips the first and last letters from SAFARI. 'one in Africa' reads like more of the hunting picture, but it defines a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The Afar are a people of Ethiopia, Eritrea and Djibouti, so one of them is a native of Africa.

clue.text: Memory of religious education: prayer uplifted me briefly

parts.note: RE is the school subject Religious Education
a collect is a short one-sentence prayer in church liturgy
the single letter I stands in short for the speaker, me
on can mean raised up and active, as when a light is turned up

explanation.surface: Recalling religious education lessons, where a prayer lifted the speaker's spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: A collect is the short prayer set for a particular day in Anglican services.
explanation.definitionFit: A recollection is something remembered, a recalled event or the act of recalling.

clue.text: Contrary daughter dropping out is turned away

indicators.note: the daughter letter falling out of the word means it is removed

parts.note: adverse means contrary or opposing
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A contrary daughter who drops out of school is shown the door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping out' removes the D from ADVERSE.
explanation.definitionFit: From Latin aversus, literally turned away, the word describes someone disinclined or opposed.

clue.text: One sheep carrying letter is followed by another message

indicators.note: the second sheep word comes after the first
the sheep word holds the letter inside it

parts.note: a teg is a sheep in its second year
EL is the spelt-out name of the letter L
another sheep, a male one: a ram

explanation.surface: A sheep with a letter is trailed by a second animal bearing a message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' means the first sheep holds the letter; a teg is a sheep in its second year, a farming word rarely met outside crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire sent by the telegraph service was a short written message.

clue.text: Fell a tree for pulping; when energy's involved he'll deliver

indicators.note: the energy letter is wrapped up inside the remixed letters
pulping breaks material down and reforms it, so the letters are remixed

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy; the 's here is 'is'

explanation.surface: Felling a tree for paper pulp, with the energy used, so someone can deliver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for pulping' signals the anagram and 'involved' the insertion of the energy letter. The paper made from pulp is what he hands out.
explanation.definitionFit: A leafleteer distributes handbills door to door or in the street.

clue.text: Programme in radio's very distracting

indicators.note: used as a verb, to programme letters is to set them in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the 's giving an S

explanation.surface: A programme on the radio is very distracting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Programme' looks like a noun but is the anagram signal on IN RADIOS VERY.
explanation.definitionFit: A diversionary tactic is one meant to draw attention elsewhere.

clue.text: Established Church in permanent position in seventh heaven

parts.note: EC is the abbreviation for Established Church
static means fixed in one place, not moving

explanation.surface: The Established Church settled firmly in its place, in a state of bliss.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ecstatic is overwhelmed with joy, as if transported to the highest heaven.

clue.text: Bleat about unsound grid: it's not right to make a song

indicators.note: the bleat goes round the scrambled letters

parts.note: maa is the bleat of a sheep or goat

indicators.note: an unsound grid is broken, so its letters are disordered

parts.note: L for left, the side that is not right

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a faulty grid, protesting it is wrong to make a song about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the bleat round the 'unsound' grid letters; 'it's not right' gives the left abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a part-song for several voices, usually unaccompanied.

clue.text: Lib Dem spokesman keeping girl provided with information initially to be marked SECRET

indicators.note: the politician's name holds the following pieces inside it

parts.note: Vince Cable was a leading Liberal Democrat spokesman at the time
a lass is a girl
if means provided that

indicators.note: only the opening letter of information is used

explanation.surface: A Liberal Democrat spokesman holding back a girl's briefing that ought to be stamped SECRET.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' means the politician's surname holds the rest. Vince Cable was a prominent British Liberal Democrat politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Material that can be given a security grading such as SECRET is capable of being so labelled.

clue.text: She makes you feel frisky not old

indicators.note: frisky letters are lively and jumbled into a new order
not marks the old letter as missing from the mix

explanation.surface: An attractive woman makes you feel young and playful again.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange YOU FEEL less O (old) for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyeful is a strikingly attractive woman, a sight worth looking at.

clue.text: Stephen Potter

parts.note: Stephen Potter was a humorous writer, but read as a snooker player named Stephen who pots balls

explanation.surface: The name of the English author of Gamesmanship.
explanation.walkthrough: Stephen Potter wrote Gamesmanship; here a potter is a snooker player, and the Stephen meant is the Scottish seven-time world champion.
explanation.definitionFit: Stephen Hendry is a Scottish snooker champion, and a snooker player pots balls.

clue.text: Pie shop's total take?

definitions.meaning: a pastry folded over a filling, such as an apple one
the total sales income of a business over a period

explanation.surface: A baker's shop wonders how much it has made in all.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a folded fruit pastry and a firm's gross revenue.

clue.text: Getting about in successor to Jaguar's XK150, i.e. replica

indicators.note: the about letter goes inside the car's name

parts.note: the Jaguar E-Type replaced the XK150 sports car in 1961
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Something about the classic Jaguar that followed the XK150 being a mere copy.
explanation.walkthrough: C goes 'in' ETYPE after its E.
explanation.definitionFit: An ectype is a copy or reproduction, as opposed to the original prototype.

clue.text: Cheat 21 computers

indicators.note: the answer to 21 across, read as an instruction to turn over, i.e. flip the word

parts.note: Macs are Apple Macintosh computers

explanation.surface: A cross-reference that reads like a fraud involving twenty-one computers.
explanation.walkthrough: '21' points to 21 across, read as 'turn over', which flips MACS.
explanation.definitionFit: A scam is a swindle or con, a dishonest trick.

clue.text: Off-sales purchase is in African republic

definitions.meaning: something bought to take away and consume elsewhere, a takeaway order
the West African state between Ghana and Benin

explanation.surface: Buying drink to take home in a West African country.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase used when ordering takeaway food also spells the name of the West African country.

clue.text: What has the Queen on head? Tick "Wearing a scarf"

indicators.note: the tick word has the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a ked is a sheep tick, a bloodsucking fly
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the abbreviation for the Queen
a chief is a head or leader

explanation.surface: A riddle about what has the Queen on its head, answered by ticking a box marked Wearing a scarf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What has' makes the tick the container; 'on' just sets the Queen above the head in the order of the answer. A ked is a sheep tick.
explanation.definitionFit: A kerchief is a cloth worn over the head, so someone wearing one is so covered.

clue.text: Mobile in Alabama's data storage unit

definitions.meaning: Americans call a mobile phone by this short name; Mobile is also a city in Alabama
the smallest unit of computer memory or a spreadsheet box

explanation.surface: A data storage facility in the Alabama city of Mobile.
explanation.definitionFit: American English shortens the mobile phone to this word, which also names a unit holding one item of data.

clue.text: Mini Coopers' first rally: racing as in The Italian Job

indicators.note: letters racing around are mixed up
only the opening letter of Coopers' is taken

explanation.surface: Mini Coopers on their first rally, tearing about like the cars in the 1969 heist film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'racing' mixes MINI, C and RALLY. The Italian Job is a British film about a gold robbery with Mini Coopers as getaway cars.
explanation.definitionFit: The film depicts a robbery, so its characters behave unlawfully, in the manner of crooks.
